[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Ask questions about each item to decide whether to keep it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Keep only items that spark joy, as per Marie Kondo's method.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Organize remaining items in a way that makes sense to the user.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Implement a "one in, one out" policy for new items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips included color-coding clothes, storing out-of-season clothes, using dividers or bins, and keeping frequently worn items at eye level.
